ablation.name: d8a_heads8_15ep
ablation.notes: D8a: Width scaling via attention heads. style_attn_num_heads 4->8 (2x more style feature subspaces at SAME depth). Theory: D7b depth scaling failed (-0.017 DINO-sty) because more layers = more content abstraction. D8a adds capacity by increasing head count, not depth. More heads = more diverse style feature subspaces without adding content abstraction layers. Same 4-layer backbone, same gate_init=0.3, only head count changes. bs=96 for VRAM safety (heads add ~5% params).
